intro: One cob of boiled corn without butter has about 120 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the carbs in the corn kernels.

variants.name: Corn cup with butter and condensed milk

diet: Yes, boiled corn is a filling snack with moderate calories. It has fibre and takes a while to chew. What adds calories is usually the butter, margarine and condensed milk at the pasar malam. Ask for less topping and it's a good snack.
tips: At the pasar malam, ask for a corn cup without condensed milk or with half the butter.
Sprinkle a little salt or pepper for flavour without extra calories.
Have corn as your afternoon carb, and reduce rice at dinner.

swap.name: Guava, 1 medium
swap.why: Fewer calories, high in fibre and vitamin C, great for an afternoon snack.

faq.q: Is corn a vegetable or a carb?
faq.a: Nutrition-wise, corn is closer to carbs like rice or tapioca. Don't count it as a vegetable.

faq.q: Is sweet corn high in sugar?
faq.a: It has a little natural sugar, but it's mostly starch and fibre. One cob is still a moderate snack.

faq.q: How long should I boil corn?
faq.a: About 10 to 15 minutes in boiling water, until the kernels are soft.
